links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT answers about hand surgery vs ASSH HandCare materials
links.effect: AI responses: mean Flesch Kincaid Reading Ease 15, Grade Level 34 (college level); ASSH HandCare: grade level 9, reading ease 60 (eighth/ninth grade).
links.quote: For AI responses, the mean Flesch Kinkaid Reading Ease score was 15, and the Flesch Kinkaid Grade Level was 34, which is considered to be college level.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient information compared with appropriate patient reading level
links.effect: AI answers required college-level reading (FK Grade Level 34, Reading Ease 15) versus eighth/ninth grade for ASSH materials (grade 9, ease 60).
links.quote: Furthermore, a high reading level was required to comprehend the information presented.

links.outcome: Source attribution and citation in ChatGPT answers (JAMA benchmark)
links.effect: JAMA benchmark score 0/4 for AI versus 3/4 for ASSH; points lost for lack of attribution, reliability and currency of sources.
links.quote: The areas in which the AI model lost points were primarily related to the lack of attribution, reliability and currency of the source material.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's answers to common hand surgery patient questions compared to professional society patient education materials, evaluating readability and quality without testing a specific deployment practice.
